node_defaults.scope: Exactly the stated contract, model or conditional proposition. No automatic biological or phenomenal instantiation.

rule_defaults.alternative_routes: Separate rules are OR routes; each all_of is AND.

nodes.statement: Separate basal nonempty experience, independently named selected phenomenal target, complete experiential structural type and particular-process continuation. Loss at one level does not entail loss at every level.

Fix finite physically grounded slots V, reference P0, K, interval I, histories H, external support B, transformation pi(S), independent target T and acceptance set. F(S)=1 iff every h in H yields an admitted successful target comparison. Undefined targets fail this test only.
One fixed CONTRACT gives a nonempty success family F on finite V. Declare whether the domain is a toy or an actual application; this premise does not identify a human phenomenal target.
M={S in F:no successful proper subset of S}; K_required=intersection(F). Inclusion-minimality is not minimum cardinality, leastness or single-deletion local minimality.

Each S in a nonempty finite success family contains a minimal successful member. Finite descent may use multi-component set reductions and does not establish a physically safe one-at-a-time deletion path.
For the same nonempty finite family, intersection(F)=intersection(M). The common required set need not itself be sufficient.
A least successful set exists iff intersection(F) belongs to F iff M has exactly one member, in the same finite nonempty contract.
Two contracts share V, transformation policy, H and B. Their nonempty success families satisfy F2 subset F1 because preservation of T2 entails preservation of T1.
Under TARGET_NESTING each F2-successful set contains an F1-minimal support, and K_required(T1) subset K_required(T2). The two minimal families need not be nested collections.
On this fixed contract success is upward closed: if S succeeds and S subset T subset V then T succeeds. Additional retained mechanisms are not presumed harmless without this premise.
Under MONOTONE a retained S succeeds iff it contains a member of M. A removed D destroys success iff D intersects every M. Minimal destructive cuts are minimal hitting sets.

C holds q and the return receiver/input combiner. Present R1/R2 copy q and absent relays supply 0. q_next=(R1*q OR R2*q) XOR V*u XOR A*w. REP is read-only; absent C makes the chosen q target undefined. Power and clock are fixed external support.

In RELAY_SETUP the initial-q distinction persists under every common input sequence iff C and (R1 or R2). Minimal supports are {C,R1},{C,R2}, common {C} fails, and minimal destructive cuts are {C},{R1,R2}.

Removing V or REP preserves initial-q distinction when C and a relay remain; removing V removes sensitivity to u. Retention plus u-sensitivity has minimal supports {C,R1,V},{C,R2,V}. No variable measures a feeling.
C contains q and an agreement gate. Installed A/B give gate values 1; excised inputs give 0. With C present q_next=q when A=B and q_next=0 otherwise. Absent C fails the selected q target.

Under GATE_SETUP only {C} and {C,A,B} preserve the initial-bit distinction. Every single cut from the full set fails although {C} succeeds. Single-deletion irreducibility is not inclusion-minimality without further conditions.

Starting at q=1,A=B=1, simultaneous A/B removal preserves q=1; removing A, permitting an update, then removing B leaves q=0. The final support/law matches but pointed states differ. No ghost-history claim is made.

Independently establish actual bearer/reference and continuation, relevant complete physical realization, common K/I/B/pi and noncircular selected phenomenal interpretation for one comparison. The toy does not supply this human instance.

With ACTUAL_BRIDGE and C1, a justified target-preserving or target-changing organizational relation receives its corresponding experiential interpretation. A failed toy target alone entails neither absent basal experience nor loss of a person nor any named feeling.

Independently establish that local P remains an actual process with constitutive dynamics and lineage through I while embedded in actual Q. Mere inclusion is not evidence of persistence after real cessation.

With PERSISTING_INSTANCE, A:P3 and A:U1 the continuing local process retains nonempty experience. An independently admitted actual whole also falls under U1. Neither implies unchanged local content or preservation of the former human target.

No universal anatomical human core, uniquely minimal subject, cell quale label or complete human-target preservation is identified. Defining a target-relative support family does not prove a human realizes it.
Grounded shared physical identity and sort-preserving local isomorphisms induce coherent overlap maps and a quotient preserving local injections; no subjective-event or subject identity follows.

If every allowed primitive tuple is covered or supplied and all facts are jointly realizable, local/interface data determine the full labeled structure within the declared class. Carrier coverage alone is insufficient.

Given an actual whole, complete physically grounded open composition, strong C1, valid local actual instances where invoked and intended comparison compatibility, whole experiential type is the transported assembly.

Local constitutive isomorphisms preserving states, ports, interventions, overlap identities, joint mechanisms, wiring, timing and well-posedness induce whole structural equivalence; actual C1 interpretation is additional.

For unrestricted n-input Boolean laws with fixed zero-anchor scopes and cover downset D, compatible local records leave 2^(2^n-|D|) update laws. This is not full physical-implementation reconstruction.
Parity versus parity XOR joint product agree on all proper zero-anchor faces, but their reversible memory embeddings have different fixed-point counts at the same one-step clock.
For finite abelian G with q elements,n>=2,c(x)=sum x_i,m=q^(n-1), L_Q(x,xprime)=Q(c(x),c(xprime))/m lifts arbitrary stochastic Q with uniform proper next-coordinate marginals for every previous x.

Fresh masks, one proper post-refresh read per step, no pooled full-state/mask information, fixed refresh law and common accessible initial information imply identical finite adaptive transcript laws across Q.
For BR=I,L=RQB, L^k=RQ^kB and trace(L^k)=trace(Q^k). Fix the same sampled clock. Macro return is not complete microstate return.

Independently addressable parity layers can implement collective memory. A deterministic four-cycle cannot be a product of two deterministic binary systems at the same step. Neither decomposition count establishes subjects.

For Qrho=rho I+(1-rho)J/q, uniform initial target and no writes, an installed joint decoder at lag k attains [1+(q-1)rho^k]/q while the restricted proper-readout protocol attains 1/q. This is specified recall, not experiential intensity.

rules.proof_sketch: Finite descent through successful proper subsets.
M subset F gives one inclusion; choose a minimal member inside every S for the reverse.
A successful intersection is least; a unique minimal member is contained in every success.
Apply finite descent inside F1 to each F2 member and intersect nested families.
Upward closure makes containing a minimal support sufficient; negate and complement.
Paired trajectory XOR cancels common inputs; at least one relay plus C retains the bit distinction.
Initial differences cancel common inputs; u changes q_next exactly when V is present.
With C, exactly the equal A/B settings preserve the initial difference.
An intermediate mismatched update erases q; simultaneous deletion avoids it.
Use C1 only for the independently grounded same actual comparison/target; the toy does not discharge ACTUAL_BRIDGE.
P3 retains actual tokenhood; U1 applies independently of preservation of the whole target.
